write_up: This is a strong FP&A resume! At Lakeshore Foods, you show both the decisions you support and what changed, from forecast accuracy to gross margin. Your earlier work at Midway Brands adds plant reporting and automation.

The forecast line is a great model: it names what you built and shows the error before and after. Your experience leads, and the move from Financial Analyst to Senior Financial Analyst is easy to follow.

Your resume isn’t the thing I’d worry about in a search. The match with an opening and the competition still matter. If you’re aiming for a manager role, add any planning direction you set, then consider bringing the pricing result higher in the Lakeshore Foods role.
